tools.name: hugging_kreuzberg-extract_bytes
tools.description: Accepts base64-encoded file data or a full data URL (e.g. data:image/png;base64,...), decodes to binary, and POSTs to Kreuzberg POST /extract as multipart form data. Returns extracted text, metadata, and tables.

tools.name: hugging_kreuzberg-extract_structured
tools.description: Accepts base64-encoded file data or a full data URL (e.g. data:image/png;base64,...). Schema and model are configured server-side via environment variables. POSTs to Kreuzberg POST /extract-structured as multipart form data.
